concepts.name: 星形桥梁
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single square, high-resolution professional identity concept presentation board for the desktop app StarBridge.
Brand context: StarBridge connects a user's own computers and servers across networks, prioritizing direct device-to-device connections with relay fallback. The actual product uses a restrained graphite grey UI, primary #4e5a6a, ink #2b3441, pale neutral surfaces. The mark needs to work at 20px in a desktop title bar and as an app icon.
Art direction: sophisticated, original, highly simplified flat vector-style brand identity, strong silhouette, balanced negative space, beautifully judged optical proportions. The board is an editorial design sheet, not a rendered physical object. Square canvas, generous margins, subtle hairline dividers, off-white background. Unified exact graphite palette, no texture, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows. The top-left has the small concept identifier. Upper 55% shows one large symbol on open off-white space. Below, show that same symbol beside the wordmark StarBridge in a beautifully spaced neutral modern sans-serif, exact capitalization. Bottom row: three evenly spaced application samples of THE SAME IDENTICAL mark: white mark in a graphite rounded-square app tile, graphite monochrome mark on white, a tiny faithful titlebar sample reading StarBridge. Show small-scale utility clearly; don't show a whole UI. The primary mark must be a distinctive standalone symbol, not just typography.
Constraints: ONE coherent logo concept, repeated faithfully in applications. All geometry simple enough to reproduce as SVG later. Do not introduce a shield, lock, planet landscape, rocket, mountain, cloud, detailed network, generic AI sparkle logo, or extra slogan. No Chinese name has been approved. Text only the specified small concept identifier and the wordmark "StarBridge"; no other captions or tiny gibberish. Spell brand S-t-a-r-B-r-i-d-g-e. Crisp edges, no watermarks.
Concept 01 / STAR SPAN: create a calm, architectural bridge icon. Two sturdy, compact end piers support one elegant shallow arch/span. The center has a distinctive four-point star cut into the bridge as NEGATIVE SPACE, structurally integrated rather than a decorative sparkle perched above. Reduce the bridge to 3–4 bold intentional geometric masses; no cables, rails, suspension structure, or landscape. The bridge and star must form a single balanced emblem. The bridge idea must read immediately and the star remain a secondary discovery. Sophisticated rounded geometric proportions, wide stable silhouette. Exact identifier text "01 / STAR SPAN".

Concept 02 / LINKED S: create an abstract S-shaped connection symbol built from TWO interlocking, offset, broad geometric links with open ends, forming one flowing S silhouette and a clear through-passage in negative space. Aim for an elegant purpose-built software glyph, not a literal chain drawing. Two halves are equal partners, united with a clever central join. Rounded exterior corners, clean hard interior cutouts, compact near-square silhouette. No star at all. The design should suggest direct connection between peers and subtly recall the S in StarBridge. Avoid resemblance to currency or Superman. Exact identifier text "02 / LINKED S".

Concept 03 / ORBIT GATE: create a distinctive minimal orbit intersection emblem showing two distant endpoints meeting through one central gateway. Two thick, clean elliptical arc fragments cross at opposing angles, with a small crisp diamond-shaped negative-space aperture at the center; keep it sparse and perfectly legible, with exactly two small endpoint nodes integrated into the arc ends. Bold connected silhouette, not a thin atom model, no planet, no globe, no science atom stereotype. The paths carry the idea of crossing network boundaries. Primarily graphite #4e5a6a, with a SINGLE restrained muted ice-blue endpoint accent #86a5bb in the large color mark and wordmark lockup; monochrome application is fully graphite or white. Small application samples keep exactly the same geometry. Exact identifier text "03 / ORBIT GATE".

Concept 04 / BRIDGE PORTAL: create a minimal architectural portal monogram, a compact bold symbol with a subtly B-shaped silhouette. Start from a near-square rounded doorway frame with a clear central channel, then create two short horizontal bridge stubs projecting inward from opposing sides and almost meeting at the center. The negative-space passage is open and intentional, suggesting two computers connected through a gateway. This should be the most restrained and industrial of the four concepts: orthogonal construction, softened corners, broad positive shapes, no stars, no orbits, no literal doors or windows. Do not merely set the letter B in a font. One highly memorable custom cut-out glyph. Exact identifier text "04 / BRIDGE PORTAL".
